$comment: Place at apps/<your-app>/mutest.config.json. App packages get a more pragmatic bar — UI integration tests can't kill every mutant economically.
$comment_excluded: Apps usually want a few exclusions for code that's economically infeasible to mutation-test. String literals in UI copy and ObjectLiteral on style/className props are common candidates — but only add these AFTER reviewing the survivors, not preemptively.
